description: Plan domain instance per cycle_type. Feature = execution-ready tech plan (P9 intent chain + outline). Topic = architecture-oriented plan (separate intent chain TBD).

fields.domain_id: unique identifier for this domain slice
fields.cognitive_frame: the analytical lens this domain uses to frame problems (what questions it asks, what it treats as relevant)
fields.information_nature: the characteristic information types this domain works with (structural relationships, process flows, state transitions, specifications, trade-off comparisons, …)
fields.expression_conventions: the expressive norms and inertia of this domain — what forms are idiomatic, what registers are expected, what is considered well-formed communication
fields.intent_anchor: how this domain locks intent and prevents drift — what makes content traceable and interpretation-space minimal
fields.audience_type: who consumes this document and what they need to extract from it
